LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 LANGUAGE PATTERN

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify sentences featuring the target language patterns: use of too...to/for and use of Must/Should with an Adverb/Adverbial
2. use the language patterns in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 LANGUAGE PATTERN
Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify sentences featuring the target language patterns: use of too...to/for and use of Must/Should with an Adverb/Adverbial
2. use the language patterns in sentences correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
